test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In this question, two statements, I and II, have been given. These statements may be independent causes, or effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of the statements may be the effect of the other statement. Read both the statements and select the correct answer.

I. Consumption of sugar has been found out as the main reason for people having diabetes

II. People are avoiding having foods with more sugar content

options.text: Both I and II are effects of independent causes
I is the cause and II is its possible effect
Both I and II are independent causes
II is the cause and I is its possible effect

solution:
**Logic followed here is,**

Statement I indicates that high sugar consumption causes diabetes.

Statement II suggests people are reacting to the knowledge that sugar causes diabetes.

⇒ Statement I is the cause.

⇒ Statement II is the effect of Statement I.

**∴ I is the cause and II is its possible effect.**

**Hence the correct answer is Option 2.**
